cautions.en: Context Graph API overage is billed at $0.01 per additional query beyond the plan quota.

capabilities.en: API request building, testing, documentation, and mocking in a single client.
Team collaboration on shared API collections with role-based access control on paid tiers.
Built-in AI assistant (Postbot) and Context Graph API for AI-assisted API work, credit-metered.

limitations.en: Free plan caps integrations at 5 and monthly API calls at 10,000, restrictive for active teams.
Collection version recovery window is only 1 day on Free, versus 30-90 days on paid tiers.

reason.en: Direct lightweight competitor for API client/testing workflows.
